description: Earlier versions of a service that can be put back online, newest first. Each entry has an `image` (pass it to runzero_activate_version or runzero_preview_version), when it was built, and `summary` — the commit message, i.e. what changed. `active: true` marks what is online now. Use this when the user refers to an earlier state ("wie gestern", "vor der Umgestaltung"). Omit `service` when the app has only one.
name: runzero_list_versions
title: List versions
